column1: # Frozen-Python golden drift registry. One row per golden test set that a pull request must run early (ci/check_golden_drift.sh).
# Columns (tab separated): package<TAB>-run regex<TAB>triggers. The build tag is always `integration`; every row starts a
# PostgreSQL container, so the job needs docker.
# triggers: `;` separated shell case patterns matched against each changed path (`*` also matches `/`). @MIG expands to the
# migration paths (see ci/check_golden_drift.sh). A change that matches a trigger runs the row. Add the package directory of the
# golden test and the paths of the writers it compares.
# A row is added only after its test names are checked: internal/cigates/scripts/golden_drift_test.go lists the tests each
# regex matches and fails when one matches none.
